pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. OBJECT-ONLY group of a brown guitar, a plain green closed book with completely blank cover, and a tan artist palette with simple colored paint dots and one brush. Clear dark outlines, solid fills, all objects whole and separated. Different leisure hobbies; no words, music notes or people. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
